title: 2027: IIMT Rohtak Offers Affordable Professional Education with AI
description: Rohtak (Haryana) [India], September 10: As Artificial Intelligence (AI), digital technologies and data-driven decision-making continue to reshape industries, the expectations from higher education are evolving rapidly. Students today are looking for institutions that not only offer academic qualifications but also prepare them with practical skills, industry exposure and future-ready competencies. Responding to these changing educational needs, IIMT Rohtak - Indraprastha Institute Of Management & Technology has announced the commencement of Admissions 2026 for its MBA, BBA and BCA programmes, introducing an academic approach that combines affordability with AI-integrated learning and industry-oriented education.

title: Travel scams are getting harder to spot. Here's how to stay safe
description: If you're booking a trip soon, you need to watch out for travel scams. They're getting more sophisticated, and scammers using new artificial intelligence tools have become better at creating fake websites and using stolen data to their advantage. If you get an unexpected text or email from your hotel asking for a payment, find their number online and call them directly to ask if it's legitimate. If you get a text saying your flight has been canceled and offering to help you rebook, go to the airline's website and check with them directly. And don't post photos of your plane tickets on social media.
